    {"op": "release", "slot": 1}

  "rationale": "Resubmission of the round-1 native_accepted program, which is provably optimal on the lexicographic objective [2,14,2]. Waits=2 is the minimum: publish requires an initialized value with no pending read, and at least one reachable state after each read leaves it incomplete, so wait_reads is unavoidable; symmetrically release requires no pending transfer, forcing wait_writes. With waits fixed at 2, only one read batch and one write batch exist, so each slot performs its full lifecycle at most once; expected=[0,1] needs two distinct pages, so two slots must be live simultaneously (a peak-1 schedule would need a second reserve/read cycle, i.e. 4 waits, losing the primary criterion). Each slot then needs exactly reserve+read+publish+acquire+write+release = 6 commands, giving 12+2=14, the minimum. Safety under arbitrary completion order: both reads are issued before the single blocking wait_reads, which drains the entire (non-FIFO) read queue, so both slots are initialized at every state reachable at publish/acquire/write time; writes target distinct destinations from distinct acquired slots, and the single blocking wait_writes drains all pending writes before either release. Final state: pc=end, no pending transfers, all slots free, dst0 origin 0 and dst1 origin 1 matching expected. Peak live slots = 2. No timing assumptions beyond DMA eventual-completion fairness; all interleavings of read/write completions with issuance are safe."
}
